entry.prompt: Ancient elven waystone: one squat chunky pale standing stone, thick and blocky, about as wide as it is tall, with a rounded pointed-arch top, rising from a low broad mossy boulder foot wider than the stone, a deep flowing carved groove of leaves and curls on its front face. Low-poly game asset for a top-down strategy game, stylized painted realism. Chunky faceted planes, hard edges, flat faces, solid closed volume. About 0.9 m wide, 0.6 m deep and 0.9 m tall. Isolated, no ground, no base plate, no text.
entry.texture: Stylized matte painted colours, even lighting, no baked shadows. Stone: pale ivory (#E6E0CE) with cool grey shadows (#A7ABA2). Carved grooves: softly glowing pale teal (#8FDCCB), the brightest colour on the model. Moss on the foot and the top edge: fresh green (#6E9A55). Abstract leaf and curl patterns only, no letters, no readable symbols, no text or logos.
